test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
On the basis of tribal population (2011), identify the option that arranges the following states in ascending order.

A. Madhya Pradesh

B. Maharashtra

C. Odisha
solution:
**The Correct answer is: "3) (C), (B), (A)"**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tribal Population Analysis:**

 
 
• Based on the 2011 Census of India, understanding the tribal population distribution is crucial for socio-economic planning and resource allocation.
 
• The census data include comprehensive details about various demographic indicators, including the population of Scheduled Tribes (ST).
 
 
 
• **Odisha (C):**
 
 
• Odisha has a significant tribal population, but it is lesser than that of Maharashtra and Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The major tribes in Odisha include the Kondh, Santal, and Munda among others.
 
• The total tribal population in Odisha as per the 2011 Census is approximately 9.59 million.
 
 
 
• **Maharashtra (B):**
 
 
• Maharashtra has a higher tribal population compared to Odisha but less than Madhya Pradesh.
 
• The prominent tribes in Maharashtra include the Bhil, Gond, and Warli among others.
 
• The total tribal population in Maharashtra as per the 2011 Census is approximately 10.51 million.
 
 
 
• **Madhya Pradesh (A):**
 
 
• Madhya Pradesh has the highest tribal population among the three states mentioned.
 
• Tribes such as the Gond, Bhil, Baiga, and Korku inhabit this state.
 
• The total tribal population in Madhya Pradesh as per the 2011 Census is approximately 15.31 million.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Importance of Tribal Population Data: **

 
 
• Tribal population data helps in formulating policies for the upliftment and welfare of tribal communities.
 
• The data is also used in designing targeted developmental programs to improve infrastructure, education, and healthcare in tribal areas.
 
 
 
• **Government Policies and Schemes:**
 
 
• Various schemes such as the Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana and Integrated Tribal Development Program (ITDP) are aimed at the holistic development of tribal areas.
 
• Tribal sub-plan (TSP) funds are allocated for the development of tribal-dominated areas to ensure equitable growth.
